_comment: Two defects. The +3{p} is UNCONDITIONAL and applies to your NEXT attack action card this turn -- it was MODIFY_ATTACK (the CURRENT attack, of which there is none when this resolves) gated on not-played-from-arsenal, which the card never says. Only the opt 2 depends on the arsenal. PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL now reads `value`, so the positive form is expressible; before, value:false returned the POSITIVE answer and the two branches were swapped.
